// src/services/authService.js
import axios from 'axios';

export async function login(email, password) {
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      'https://api.example.com/api/v2/authenticate',
      { email, password },
      {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      }
    );
    // NOTE: The API returns { token: '...', expiresIn: 3600 }
    // Store the token for subsequent requests
    const { token } = response.data;
    localStorage.setItem('authToken', token);
    return token;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Login failed:', err.response?.data || err.message);
    throw err;
  }
}

answer_sentences.text: The relevant log block spans from line 1 to line 22, capturing the sequence of SSL/TLS failures for both the payment gateway and analytics endpoint.

Lines 2-10 detail the Python-side `urllib3.exceptions.SSLError` caused by an expired certificate on `payments.example.com`, while lines 12-20 show the Java-side `javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException` and subsequent hostname mismatch errors for `payments.internal.local`.
Line 11 explicitly notes the certificate expiration date of 2024-02-28, and line 17 confirms the hostname mismatch between `payments.example.com` and `payments.internal.local`.
